zh: 每条查询都要精确匹配 key 和 timestamp 两个字段，而本站保证这一对唯一且查询一定存在。
把 (key, timestamp) 这对字段合成一个键放进哈希表，值存对应的 value，每次查询就是一次查表。
读入 n 条记录，以 key+分隔符+timestamp 为键存 value（按原字符串保存即可）；再对 q 条查询逐个取出 value，用空格连接后输出一行。
en: Every query must match both fields, key and timestamp, exactly, and the site guarantees that each pair is unique and that every query exists.
Combine the pair (key, timestamp) into a single key in a hash map whose value is the record's value; each query is then a single lookup.
Read the n records and store value under key + separator + timestamp (keeping the original strings); then look up each of the q queries in order and print the values joined by spaces on one line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use (key, timestamp) as a dictionary key; for each query, look it up exactly and output the value.

## Correctness

The site guarantees that every query exists and that keys are unique. A lookup on the full two-field key matches if and only if both fields match, so it finds the single corresponding record.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n+q), space O(n).
